title: ConDefects: A New Dataset to Address the Data Leakage Concern for LLM-based Fault Localization and Program Repair

bias_targets.methodology: Creating a meticulously curated, time-stamped dataset of programming faults (ConDefects) introduced after the training data cut-off dates of popular LLMs to prevent artificially inflated and misleading performance metrics caused by models having prior exposure to benchmark data.

Categorizing and balancing the coding tasks across three distinct difficulty levels (Low, Medium, High) using AtCoder's rating system to ensure machine learning models are evaluated equitably and do not over-specialize or bias towards particular problem types.
